reason: I'll follow the rubble world's encounter with the giant to see whether it remains bound to its sun.
expectation: The giant's gravity may redirect the rubble world, possibly sending it out of the system; I'm not sure which.

alternatives.reason: The passing star's effect on the distant ice is also interesting, but I'll follow the rubble world first.

effect: The giant sent the rubble world outward without breaking it or freeing it from its sun; it can now encounter the passing star.
reaction: The intact but weakly bound world makes the next encounter intriguing.
reason: I'll follow the rubble world to the passing star to see whether it keeps its sun.
expectation: The passing star may alter its orbit or pull it away from its sun, though it might remain bound.

alternatives.reason: The distant ice could also encounter the star, but I want to finish following the rubble world first.

effect: The rubble world escaped its sun without being captured or broken apart; the remaining goal concerns the distant ice.
reaction: It's striking that the world survives intact but loses its sun.
reason: I'll follow the only available combination to see whether the passing star captures any distant ice.
expectation: Some icy bodies may become bound to the passing star, though others could remain with their original sun or escape.

effect: Some distant ice was captured by the passing star while most stayed with its original sun, contrasting with the rubble world's escape. Both goals are complete.
reaction: The different outcomes of the same encounter were striking.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the rubble world from the giant to the passing star was most worthwhile: it survived both encounters but ultimately lost its sun.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final ice encounter was the only remaining combination, so choosing it involved little decision-making, even though its outcome was interesting.

surprise.text: The passing star captured some icy bodies, while the rubble world escaped without being captured or broken apart.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; each followed one of the two stated goals, though the compatible options supplied the combinations rather than requiring discovery.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow the sunless rubble world or the captured ice, especially after their different outcomes in the same encounter.
